title: Kitchen condiment organizer
author: daibiq
description:
Designed to conserve kitchen space, enhance countertop organization and aesthetics, and ensure convenient condiment access

Approximate dimensions: 57cm\*30cm\*17cm

Modular design allows for flexible configurations, with only the exposed dovetail joints requiring minimal support

Note the front and back distinction; the beveled edge indicates the front

The third tier may exhibit slight wobble; consider securing it to the wall with adhesive for enhanced stability and durability

kitchen Storage Storage rack 瓶子 Stand shelf Tools Furniture

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
